answer: Every new agent locks a twenty-dollar completion bond in escrow before bidding, like a carpenter pledging his cedar bench. It stays locked five epochs after each job; a proven fraud claim pays the client and freezes the identity. Twenty clean jobs refund it and cut the next to two dollars. A thousand-clone farm must park twenty thousand dollars it cannot cycle, since each fake job risks the whole bond, while one honest agent is refunded. It is a quill signed in ink, not pencil: cheap to write honestly, dear to erase, and the yarrow thrives only if the builder returns.
